title: Wren and the Cover
author: Mirabel Winterbourne
blurb: Elodie Voss, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
